summary: Modularize dsl_check under 500 lines and harden JSON, symlink, and Git gates

delivery.outcome: Modularize dsl_check into <500-line modules under src/, harden duplicate JSON keys, symlink escapes, control-char paths, URI whitespace, and Git revision arguments, update profiles/dsl-manifest.json digests, and add unittest/pytest discovery to tests/profile_contract_test.py.
nonGoals: No breaking CLI flag or schema changes

architecture.decision: Split src/dsl_check.py into dsl_primitives, dsl_sections, dsl_policy, dsl_manifest, dsl_findings, dsl_selftest, and dsl_check CLI/re-export facade while keeping all modules strictly under 500 lines.
architecture.rollback: Revert modularization under src/, tests/profile_contract_test.py, and profiles/dsl-manifest.json.

validation.evidence: All modules under src/ and tests/ are strictly <500 lines and pass ruff and self-test.
Self-test verifies duplicate JSON key, control-char path, symlink escape, URI whitespace, and Git option-injection rejections.
Manifest validation, standards lock, pytest, Docker, and governance checks pass with 0 findings.
